findings.title: Cache key does not account for fallback chain changes
findings.body: The LRU cache key is `"#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}"`. With the new FallbackLocaleList, the fallback chain depends on `SiteSetting.default_locale`, which can be changed at runtime by an admin. If `default_locale` changes, previously cached translations (which were resolved using the old fallback chain) will continue to be served from cache with incorrect fallback results. The cache key should incorporate the fallback chain or `SiteSetting.default_locale` to avoid stale translations.

findings.title: translate only loads the current locale, not fallback locales
findings.body: The `translate` method calls `load_locale(config.locale)` to ensure the current locale is loaded, but does not load fallback locales. When I18n fallbacks are active, `translate_no_cache` will attempt lookups in fallback locales (e.g., `SiteSetting.default_locale` and `:en`). If those locale files haven't been loaded yet (e.g., in background jobs, mailers, or any code path that doesn't go through `ApplicationController#set_locale` which calls `ensure_loaded!`), the fallback lookups will silently fail to find translations, defeating the purpose of this PR for non-controller contexts.

findings.title: FallbackLocaleList is a top-level class that inherits from Hash but never stores entries
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList` inherits from `Hash` and overrides `[]` to compute results dynamically, but never calls `super` or stores anything. Any code that iterates over the fallbacks object (e.g., `I18n.fallbacks.each`, `I18n.fallbacks.keys`) or checks `I18n.fallbacks.empty?` will get unexpected results from the empty underlying Hash. Consider inheriting from a simpler base or documenting that only `[]` is supported.

findings.title: ensure_loaded! acquires a mutex check on every request for each fallback locale
findings.body: `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!` is called on every request in `set_locale`. It iterates over the fallback chain (up to 3 locales) and for each calls `I18n.ensure_loaded!`, which checks `@loaded_locales.include?(locale)`. While the check short-circuits before the mutex when the locale is already loaded, this still adds per-request overhead proportional to the fallback chain length. For high-traffic sites, consider memoizing at the request level or checking once whether all fallbacks are loaded.
